policy.newIssueRule: Search existing open/closed issues first. Prefer updating, reopening, or adding acceptance to an existing issue over creating a new issue. Create a new issue only when the acceptance boundary is genuinely distinct.
policy.selectionRule: Workers select only from NOW unless the orchestrator explicitly promotes a NEXT item. WAITING_LIVE, RESEARCH, FUTURE, REFERENCE_ONLY, unclassified BACKLOG, and every "historical" row are not normal coding work.
policy.completionRule: Before starting another NOW item, land or explicitly block the current lane, update evidence state, and reconcile the issue. Do not maximize issue count or commit count.
policy.foldRule: A consolidation fold is NOT a fix. Fold only after copying the slice's acceptance into a checklist row on the umbrella, close the slice as a tracking fold, and record it under "historical" with a note naming the umbrella. The umbrella row stays open until its own acceptance is verified live or explicitly dropped.
